purpose: This table is a small reference dataset mapping two-letter airline carrier codes to their full legal airline names, intended to be joined against flight fact tables to enrich records with human-readable carrier names.
usage: Join downstream flight tables to this table on carrier_code (carrier) to resolve carrier_name; since null_rate is 0.0 for both columns and no duplicates exist, no additional filtering or null-handling logic is required by consumers.
limitations: The table covers only the 16 carriers present in this bronze snapshot at profiling time (row_count 16, duplicate_row_rate 0.0); new or retired carriers are not reflected unless the source is re-profiled, and no historical versioning of carrier names is retained.
